preRegistration.decisionProcedure: flag a change SPLIT_RECOMMENDED iff size > T, size = additions + deletions

arms.B0: no knowledge, no calibration: no row flagged ⇒ balanced accuracy 0.5 by construction
arms.B1: local-only calibration (G's B1): T_B = the size over the distinct training sizes maximizing training balanced accuracy for HIGH_ITERATION; ties ⇒ smallest T
arms.KG: knowledge-guided calibration (G2's method): T_KG = argmax over T ∈ (distinct training sizes ∪ {1000}) of [ BA_train(T) − α·| log10(max(T, 1)) − 3 | ], α = 0.05 (a 10× departure from the knowledge prior costs 0.05 balanced accuracy); ties ⇒ T closest to 1000 in |log10 T − 3|, then smallest T
arms.K_reportOnly: knowledge only, no calibration: T = 1000 (G's arm) and T = 100 — report-only continuity with G, never decisive

evaluationMethod.development: pre-registered rolling-origin (expanding window) over DEV only: rows sorted by PR number; origins o ∈ {100, 200, 300}; fit B1 and KG on rows [0, o), evaluate on rows [o, o + 100); a fold is VALID iff its training part has ≥ 5 HIGH and ≥ 5 LOW and its test part ≥ 5 HIGH and ≥ 5 LOW; record per-fold BA(B1), BA(KG), BA(T=1000) and the mean over valid folds of Δ_B,fold = BA(KG) − BA(B1). CONTAMINATED data ⇒ this can only BLOCK a PASS (necessary condition), never grant one
evaluationMethod.final: fit B1 and KG once on all 400 DEV rows; record T_B, T_KG and their sha256 (canonical JSON) BEFORE reading HB labels; evaluate on HB

preRegistration.metric: balanced accuracy (odg-binary-classification-metrics.classificationMetrics, SPLIT_RECOMMENDED vs HIGH_ITERATION) on HB. PRIMARY comparison Δ_B = BA(KG) − BA(B1); gate Δ_0 = BA(KG) − BA(B0) = BA(KG) − 0.5; n, n_HIGH, n_LOW reported
preRegistration.baseline: B0 (no knowledge, no calibration) and B1 (local-only calibration, no knowledge) — see arms; the PRIMARY reference is B1
preRegistration.uncertainty: paired bootstrap over HB rows (same resample for all arms; fitted thresholds fixed — no refit), 2000 resamples, fixed-seed LCG st = (Math.imul(st, 1664525) + 1013904223) >>> 0 (as in odg-v160-scenario-g-run); index = st % n, seed 20261202; a resample with 0 HIGH or 0 LOW is skipped and counted; CI95 = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of Δ_B and Δ_0
preRegistration.minimumN: HB ≥ 20 HIGH_ITERATION and ≥ 20 LOW_ITERATION rows; DEV fit ≥ 10 of each; ≥ 2 VALID rolling-origin folds
preRegistration.decisionRule: grade = first matching of NOT_MEASURED, PASS, PARTIAL, FAIL per thresholds, evaluated mechanically on the recorded numbers; no re-tuning of α, prior, candidates, tie rules, label, blocks, folds or seed after the run

thresholds.NOT_MEASURED: C1 refused at use time; OR DEV sha256 ≠ pinned; OR the held-out builder is not reproducible (--check differs) or violates its rule; OR minimumN not met; OR the concordance check fails; OR > 5% of bootstrap resamples skipped; OR any non-finite number
thresholds.PASS: Δ_B > 0 AND CI95 lower bound of Δ_B > 0 AND Δ_0 ≥ 0.05 AND CI95 lower bound of Δ_0 > 0 AND mean rolling-origin Δ_B ≥ 0
thresholds.PARTIAL: Δ_0 > 0 AND Δ_B ≥ −0.02 AND the PASS conditions are not all met — including T_KG = T_B (Δ_B = 0 exactly, recorded KG_EQUALS_B1: no evidence that the knowledge helps)

WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT.moduleSpec:
Export exactly one function, canonicalJson(value), that returns a deterministic canonical JSON STRING for any JSON-compatible value (null, boolean, number, string, array, plain object).
Rules, applied recursively at EVERY nesting level:
- null, booleans, numbers and strings: return JSON.stringify(value).
- arrays: "[" + each element converted with canonicalJson + joined with "," + "]" (element order kept).
- plain objects: sort the keys with the default Array.prototype.sort(), emit each key as JSON.stringify(key) + ":" + canonicalJson(child), join with ",", wrap in "{" and "}".
- no whitespace anywhere. Do not use a JSON.stringify replacer array (it drops nested keys).
Export it as: module.exports = { canonicalJson };
